labels.VALIDATED: The approach reached split-half reliability of at least 0.70 (interval lower bound at least 0.50) and an out-of-time correlation lower bound above 0.30, as declared before any result.
labels.PROVISIONAL: The approach reached split-half reliability of at least 0.50 with an interval lower bound above 0 and an out-of-time correlation lower bound above 0, but not every VALIDATED threshold.
labels.EXPLORATORY: An ordered list exists, but the declared PROVISIONAL thresholds were not met. The order is the best available description of the data and is not shown to separate players beyond noise.
labels.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: Fewer than ten players meet the declared eligibility floors or the approach cannot be computed. A player with this label is not ranked; it says nothing about the quality of the player.

row_rule: A row never carries a stronger label than its list. VALIDATED rows need a VALIDATED list, the STRONG_SUBSTANTIAL evidence class and a Top-10 inclusion probability of at least 0.5. PROVISIONAL rows need a list of at least PROVISIONAL and an inclusion probability of at least 0.25. Every other ranked row is EXPLORATORY.
two_statuses: ranking_status is the status of the submitted order. model_validation_status is the status the approach earned on the declared reliability tests. Neither can be stronger than the declared thresholds allow.
